category_title: Elementary students with mild mental retardation and language delay who struggle with complex reasoning and auditory triggers
minimal_context: The student is playing individually in a virtual environment, attempting to complete reasoning and grouping tasks across sequential learning levels.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's move to the next sequential learning level. Please look at the items on the screen and group them together.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I want to answer one question after another.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just try your best to group the items.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: This is a toy. And this is an object in the health center.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Yes, but you need to use reasoning to group them.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stops trying) The reasoning and grouping is too difficult.
